name: Shadeweaver’s Thicket
description: Shadeweaver’s Thicket is the borderland region between the Vah Shir homeland of Shar Vahl and the deeper wilds of Luclin. The outer savanna is patrolled by Vah Shir clans, while the inner thicket becomes a dense, shadowed forest filled with Grimling raiders, corrupted wildlife, and Netherbian burrow faults.
